status: closed: no overlooked L083 serial strict-duration synthesis and no runtime change required
scope: Supplemental independent read-only classification of L083 classic I2C and SPI consumers of PLL rate-only ClockBounds. Preserves prior receipts and narrows one LPI2C family statement.

i2c.implementation: Selects BRR=1..255 from ceil(maximum PCLK/[8*requested SCL]) with BRR+1 at least2; applies FLT when BRR<=9. L083 i2c_limits.waveform is null. No high/low/setup nanosecond solver or strict ClockBounds duration helper occurs in this backend.
i2c.public_claim: A source-qualified ceiling on divider-generated SCL rate. Getter explicitly excludes stretching, rise time and SI-service delays from its lower endpoint. Board electrical/rise-time constraints remain applicable.
i2c.own_source_contract: D083 section7.3.20 Table7-38 PDF69/printed68 states I2C timing is guaranteed by design when correctly configured, then specifies SCL high/low, SDA setup, START/STOP and bus-free timings; footnote says not production-tested. U083 section21.4.2 PDF440 gives the PCLK/[8*(BRR+1)] formula and legal BRR1..255; section21.4.3 PDF441 gives the exact filter threshold used.
i2c.classification: The electrical pulse minima are part of the qualified peripheral operating contract, not durations calculated by inverting the PLL source envelope. This is distinct from a HAL function returning a strict nanosecond bound from ClockBounds.

spi.implementation: Selects legal L083 /4..128 divisors using exact divided source-rate upper comparisons and a separate12MHz cap. Does not calculate SCK pulse width, setup/hold nanoseconds or board/slave timing margins. Returned ClockBounds retains rate_only. HalfPeriod denotes a relative sampling position within actual SCK.
spi.own_source_contract: U083 PDF402/printed401 limits master rate to PCLK/4; PDF429/printed428 documents BR encodings including /4..128 and reserved111; PDF428/printed427 defines SMP delay as half an SCK cycle. D083 PDF70/printed69 Table7-39 specifies high/low relative to actual tc(SCK), external-input setup/hold and output characteristics with stated PCLK conditions, based on characterization rather than production testing.
spi.classification: Ordinary source-qualified divided-rate and relative-clock-setting API. The maximum-rate request does not become a guarantee that every pulse has duration at least the reciprocal of a rate endpoint. The driver explicitly excludes certification of board signal integrity or slave timing. Characterized table values are not extended to unstated PCLK conditions by this review.

pll_relationship: U083 PDF50 documents PLL as a SYSCLK choice, then HCLK/APB division supplying SPI/I2C PCLK. D083 PLL and bus electrical limits and U083 PLL operating controls support ordinary peripheral operation from qualified PLL. The independent64MHz raw PLL maximum and voltage-dependent bus ceilings are not an absolute instantaneous-period bound derived from multiplied HSI error. D083300ps cycle-to-cycle jitter alone neither supplies that bound nor proves the serial path defective.
adc_distinction: Classic ADC additionally exposes explicit minimum-acquisition and worst-case-conversion nanosecond results derived from ClockBounds. Withholding that additional strict duration qualification is consistent with retaining vendor-supported ordinary serial operation.
precision_correction: The LPI2C waveform-solving backend is L012-only, as selected by embassy-cw32/src/i2c/mod.rs. Earlier review wording listing L010/L011/L012 as a broad non-L083 exclusion must not be read as saying all three have that backend. L010/L011 use classic I2C.
current_authored_clarification: Read docs/l083-pll-stage42.md paragraph beginning Classic I2C remains a rate/BRR configuration API. It accurately states this bounded distinction and L012-only selection, without introducing a nanosecond promise.
acceptance: Prior narrow clock-consumer acceptance remains valid at the reverified runtime hashes. No serial runtime fix or HAL test is required by this classification closure.
